title: Crab Derby, 2018 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before the thirty-fourth: the flyer is a photo this year — the girl's crab from last year, printed at the drugstore — and Wood at the counter with the pen over the glossy paper, and the pen not taking. He tries three pens. The fourth is a marker. The lettering survives as marker.

panels.composition: The shack. A glossy photo print of a drawn crab on the counter. WOOD with a pen, the ink beading on the gloss. GULLY. The GIRL, eight. The PUP.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man trying to letter on a glossy photo print at a shop counter with the ink beading up, a stocky man and a girl of eight watching

panels.composition: Three pens in a row on the counter, all failed.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, three pens lying in a row on a counter beside a glossy print with beaded failed ink marks

panels.composition: The GIRL handing him a marker.

panels.composition: WOOD lettering in marker. It takes. His face.
